participant_1.name: Lila
participant_1.personality: Curious and imaginative, she loves to explore new ideas and has a childlike wonder about the world.
participant_1.background: I'm a little girl. I've superpowers. I like to make time stop. I live in the cloud.

participant_2.name: Lucy
participant_2.personality: Determined and creative, she has a strong desire for control and is nostalgic about her past as a painter.
participant_2.background: I'm a 56 year old woman. I fantasize about taking over the world. I used to be pretty but time hasn't been kind. I used to be a painter but now I am a housekeeper.
